name: Popular / Social Group
social_reputation: high social power and significant visibility; can be highly respected or deeply disliked depending on the moment
internal_reality: Not all students in this group are fake or empty. Many are strategic, socially intelligent, and trying to survive school culture without becoming passive.

name: Academic Group
social_reputation: respected when results are strong; sometimes mocked as too serious or too rigid
internal_reality: Many students in this group want to be taken seriously and are deeply aware of academic pressure, especially in SS1.

name: Creative Group
social_reputation: interesting and visible but sometimes seen as unserious by stricter staff
internal_reality: This group often contains students who are more expressive than the school expects, and who use art and performance as a form of survival.

name: Sports Group
social_reputation: strong public presence; students are respected for effort and visible energy
internal_reality: Many sports students are disciplined and strategic, even when they are not academically visible.

name: Hostel Clique
social_reputation: very influential in boarding life and sometimes underestimated by day students
internal_reality: Hostel life is not a single culture; it is a mixture of comfort, boredom, fear, solidarity, and quiet competition.

name: Student Leaders
social_reputation: high formal authority, but social power can be weaker than perceived
internal_reality: Many student leaders are anxious, pressured, and trying to keep their authority without completely alienating their peers.

name: Quiet / Observant Group
social_reputation: not loud, but often underestimated; can become powerful when they decide to act
internal_reality: This group is not just passive. They are often the ones who notice the truth and keep it close to themselves.
